name: @animastor/assistant
description: Animastor Assistant — the AI assistant contour of the Animastor backend, physically extracted from the host: chat engine (persona/system prompts, book context, mode tools, JSON patch pipeline with bundle-contract validation), the /api/v1/ai/* HTTP contour (sessions CRUD, non-streaming chat, SSE streaming with meta/delta/done/error frames, tool-call orchestration) and the chat-session repository contract. The package reaches the host (book read/write, bundle validation, provider resolution, session persistence, shared-inference transport, logging) ONLY through the injected AssistantPorts seam — no PG, no Book internals, no filesystem, no provider gateway inside.
